source.notes: Extracted from a live Floci emulator. Config fields are observed. Usage series are SYNTHETIC (Floci has no telemetry; they are injected by synth/metrics.py). Costs are ESTIMATES from approximate list prices. Stacks are derived from VPC/name prefixes (no tags exist). features_used is omitted: Postgres extensions are not visible through the RDS API. Edges are declared by configuration only (no flow logs). The extractor never read ground_truth/.
